units.source_text: 他们到达笠置山的时候，

en.t: When they arrived at Mount Kasagi,

units.source_text: 可恶的土蜘蛛已经等在山洞门口，

en.t: the hateful tsuchigumo was already waiting at the mouth of the cave,

units.source_text: 满脸谄媚的欢迎发长彦，说道：

en.t: and welcomed Hatsunagahiko with a fawning look all over his face, saying:

units.source_text: “欢迎发长彦君远道而来，辛苦了。

en.t: "Welcome, Lord Hatsunagahiko, after your long journey. You must be tired.

units.source_text: 承蒙抬爱，请在我这吃点生鹿肝或者熊胎儿吧。”

en.t: Since you have honored me with your favor, please have some raw deer liver or bear fetus here."
